ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) pixels with a low ratio (est. <15%) of high-intensity (white/light) pixels localized at scar points and distal tip barnacle clusters.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary surface is a contiguous low-intensity black field. High-contrast yellowish-white geometric blobs are clustered at distal tips. Discrete white focal spots (circular scars) are sparsely distributed, with a cluster of three in the upper right quadrant.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central notch with a calculated interior angle of approximately 85 degrees. Depression depth is approximately 10% of total visible vertical fluke extent.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular serrated boundary with approximately 14 distinct peaks per lobe. Variations in pixel-amplitude show higher vertical displacement on the outer thirds of the trailing edge compared to the inner sections.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Leading edges exhibit a steady convex curvature sweeping from the water line to the tips. Trailing edges display an overall concave trajectory from the median notch towards the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Detection of multiple circular high-contrast white pixel clusters. High-density grouping of three circular points in the upper right lobe; individual white circular points scattered along the midline and lower left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Four distinct parallel diagonal linear disruptions (rake marks) on the upper right lobe. Sparse, shorter linear white scratches on the mid-left lobe surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant barnacle colonization forming dense, high-contrast textures at both lobe tips. Vertical rake marks on the right lobe surface.
other_distinctive_markers: The presence of extensive, raised biological growth (barnacles) on the extreme lateral and distal margins creating a non-uniform edge profile.
